##### Project general facts

Cavalli Tower is a 70-storey luxury residential tower located in Dubai, overlooking the Palm. The project is designed by award-winning architect Shaun Killa of Killa Design, known for iconic work such as the Museum of the Future. The tower is positioned as an ultra-exclusive branded residence and features front-facing designer apartments with direct beach access and uninterrupted 24/7 views of the Palm, Burj Al Arab, and the Dubai skyline. The overall concept emphasizes bold, high-impact architecture and a lifestyle-oriented design approach.

The development offers a wide range of high-end lifestyle amenities, including artificial beach areas, private pools, and exceptional water features integrated into the project. Residents benefit from access to the Westin Mina Seyahi private beach, waterpark membership, and a 25% discount on food and beverage services. The project is designed to deliver a resort-like living experience with continuous access to leisure, entertainment, and waterfront facilities.

The interiors are branded Cavalli interiors, characterized by bold design language, high ceilings, and rich decorative detailing throughout all living spaces. Apartments feature flexible layouts with kitchens that include artistic wall separations, allowing living areas to transform for entertaining. Bathrooms and bedrooms are designed with luxury features such as freestanding bathtubs and glass operable partitions. Kitchens come fully equipped, and there is no furnishing included. No specific appliance brands are mentioned; the overall standard is high-quality contemporary luxury finishes without furniture.

##### Location description and benefits 

Al Sufouh is one of Dubai’s most prestigious coastal communities, offering residents a perfect balance of tranquility, convenience, and urban sophistication. Nestled between some of the city’s most sought-after districts, the area provides easy access to major business hubs, world-class attractions, and beautiful beachfront destinations. Its low-density character and well-planned surroundings create a peaceful atmosphere that is highly desirable for families and professionals alike.

Residents of Al Sufouh enjoy proximity to pristine beaches, scenic waterfront promenades, and an abundance of leisure opportunities. The neighborhood is surrounded by premium dining venues, luxury hotels, renowned educational institutions, and excellent healthcare facilities, ensuring that everyday needs are met with ease. Beautiful green spaces and stunning views of the Arabian Gulf further enhance the area's appeal and contribute to an exceptional quality of life.

Connectivity is one of Al Sufouh’s greatest strengths, with convenient access to Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai Metro stations, and key destinations across the emirate. The community’s strategic location allows residents to reach major commercial centers, entertainment districts, and international airports within a short drive. Combining coastal charm, modern infrastructure, and an upscale residential environment, Al Sufouh stands out as one of Dubai’s most attractive places to call home.
